title: @SSwarper
description: Dual purposes for processing a given subject's anatomical volume: skull-strip the brain and calculate the warp to a reference template/standard space.

input_file.description: An anatomical dataset, not skull-stripped, with about 1 mm resolution.
input_file.title: Input anatomical dataset

base_template.description: A base template dataset with similar contrast to the input dataset.
base_template.title: Base template dataset

output_dir.description: Output directory for all files from this program.
output_dir.title: Output directory

no_lite.description: Do not use the '-lite' option with 3dQwarp.
no_lite.title: No lite

skip_warp.description: Do not compute past the output of anatSS.<subid>.nii.
skip_warp.title: Skip warp

unifize_off.description: Do not start with a 3dUnifize command.
unifize_off.title: Unifize off

init_skullstr_off.description: Do not preprocess with a 3dSkullstrip command.
init_skullstr_off.title: Init skullstrip off

extra_qc_off.description: Do not make extra QC images.
extra_qc_off.title: Extra QC off

jump_to_extra_qc.description: Just make the two QC*jpg images from a previous run.
jump_to_extra_qc.title: Jump to extra QC

cost_nl_init.description: Specify cost function for initial nonlinear (3dQwarp) part of alignment.
cost_nl_init.title: Initial nonlinear alignment cost function

cost_nl_final.description: Specify cost function for final nonlinear (3dQwarp) parts of alignment.
cost_nl_final.title: Final nonlinear alignment cost function

deoblique.description: Apply obliquity information to deoblique the input volume.
deoblique.title: Deoblique

deoblique_refitly.description: Purge obliquity information to deoblique the input volume.
deoblique_refitly.title: Deoblique refitly

ssopt_flag.description: Append a string of options for 3dSkullStrip.
ssopt_flag.title: 3dSkullStrip options

aniso_off.description: Do not preprocess with a 3danisosmooth command.
aniso_off.title: Aniso off

ceil_off.description: Turn off capping on values after anisosmoothing.
ceil_off.title: Ceil off

tmp_name_nice.description: Use nicer, non-random intermediate file prefix for temporary files.
tmp_name_nice.title: Temporary file naming

echo.description: Run the script with 'set echo' for extra verbosity in the terminal output.
echo.title: Echo flag

verbose.description: Apply the '-verb' option to 3dQwarp for verbose progress information.
verbose.title: Verbose flag

noclean.description: Do not delete the 'junk' files at the end of computations.
noclean.title: No clean flag
